name: Chris Ozols
description: Personal GitHub site of Chris Ozols, with mathematical proofs, counterexamples and refutations, improvements on existing records, and optimizations of existing software.

proofs.heading: Mathematical proofs
proofs.title: Mathematical Proofs — Chris Ozols
proofs.description: Proofs of published mathematical conjectures with reproducible Lean verification, exact statements, trust models, and prior-art notes. No novelty or priority is claimed.
proofs.introHtml: Mathematical proofs with reproducible verification in Lean 4. For each one, I couldn't find a previously existing solution on the internet.

refutations.heading: Mathematical refutations
refutations.title: Mathematical Refutations — Chris Ozols
refutations.description: Counterexamples to published mathematical claims, with exact witnesses, Lean verification, and prior-art notes, including disclosure of earlier refutations.
refutations.introHtml: Counterexamples and refutations with reproducible verification in Lean 4. For each one, I couldn't find a previously existing solution on the internet.
refutations.empty: No entries are published yet. Entries are added once the counterexample can be checked independently and its prior-art notes, including any earlier refutations, are complete.
